Title: Starbase Infrastructure Advances Toward Flight 14
Subtitle: Ship 42 completes cryo-proof testing at Massey's while Gigabay steel erection concludes and Pad 1 launch mount installation begins.
Author: Jordan Vale
Date: September 6, 2026
Outlet: SpaceBytes
URL: https://spacebytes.net/article/2026-09-06-starbase-infrastructure-advances-toward-flight-14/

At Massey's, Ship 42 completed two cryo-proof tests on September 3 and is expected to return to Mega Bay 2 for engine installation, with a static fire projected within six weeks. Concurrently, structural article S43.1 is undergoing testing in the supercrusher, having completed two cryo-proof tests involving actuators on the methane and liquid oxygen header tanks; catch-point and flap-hinge tests are scheduled next.
